title: eval-harness: integrate per-prompt regression metrics into CI hooks
author: Avery Chen
description:
Motivation: The eval harness currently runs per-prompt regressions as part of nightly jobs but lacks tight CI integration to catch prompt-set quality regressions earlier. This PR wires prompt-level metrics (accuracy, BLEU-lite, hallucination_rate, latency_p50/p95) into per-PR CI hooks so that regressions are surfaced on feature branches and gated when thresholds are violated.

What this change does: Adds a minimal metrics exporter and CI step that runs a small representative prompt-set (configurable) against the changed model/prompt bundle, computes delta against baseline, and fails CI if any metric crosses configured thresholds. Adds documentation and a toggle to disable expensive checks for low-cost branches. Integrates new checks into the existing GitHub Actions workflow for eval-harness.

Scope: The changes are focused in eval-harness and CI config; no runtime serving changes. This is intended as an incremental rollout: start with a lightweight sample prompt-set and extend to full daily sets after validation.

How to review: Review the new GH Actions workflow, the metric computation logic in eval_harness/ci_metrics.py, and the README section documenting configuration and thresholds. Unit tests included for metric aggregation and baseline lookup.

Related: Linear ENG-4201 (per-prompt CI gate), PM-312 (product acceptance criteria).

ci_summary: Initial CI run: unit tests passed, eval job failed on threshold guard (hallucination_rate +3.2% over baseline) causing expected break; author updated thresholds and added smoothing. Rerun: all checks passed. GitHub annotations produced for per-prompt failing items in the first run to aid triage.
release_notes: Add per-PR eval-harness CI hook that computes prompt-level metrics and gates merges on configurable thresholds. Start with a lightweight sample prompt-set; enables earlier detection of prompt-set regressions.
notes_for_ops: Enabled by default for branches targeting main. To opt out for long-running experiments set EVAL_HARNESS_CI_SAMPLE_ONLY=true or disable the workflow in .github/workflows. Metrics baselines stored in eval-harness/baselines/ and can be updated via the baseline-update.sh script.
testing_instructions: Run pytest -q eval-harness/tests to validate unit tests. Locally invoke the CI job with: python -m eval_harness.ci_metrics --prompt-set eval-harness/sample_prompt_sets/lightweight.json --baseline eval-harness/baselines/lightweight.json. The script exits non-zero when thresholds are exceeded (same behavior used in GH Actions).
